scope: Ki Blast Super Batch 252 current reconciliation

findings.name: Death Slicer
findings.note: Current Xenoverse 2 reference identifies Death Slicer as a Ki Blast Super, 100 Ki, obtained through Frieza (1st Form) training; no PQ route was substituted.

findings.name: Ki Blast Cannon
findings.note: Current Xenoverse 2 reference identifies Ki Blast Cannon as a Ki Blast Super available to CaCs; independent GameFAQs evidence supports Skill Shop acquisition. Stamina cost and Ultimate-Finish semantics remain conservative/unresolved rather than inferred.

findings.name: Dodon Ray
findings.note: Current Xenoverse 2 reference identifies Dodon Ray as a Ki Blast Super obtained through Tien training with 0 Ki; no unsupported damage value was promoted.

findings.name: Death Slash
findings.note: Current Xenoverse 2 reference and the maintained all-PQ guide identify Death Slash as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super from PQ23 — The Explosion of Namek; the guide places it in Basic Reward.

findings.name: Burst Attack
findings.note: Current Xenoverse 2 reference identifies Burst Attack as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super used by Nuova Shenron and obtained from the "I want a new Super Attack!" Shenron wish.

findings.name: Kairos Cannon
findings.note: The prior batch incorrectly preserved a character-only boundary. Current evidence identifies Kairos Cannon as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super used by Supreme Kai of Time and obtainable by the Future Warrior from Conton City Tournament Match 2 — Thinning the Herd. The repository already has a matching tournament endpoint record.

corrections: Kairos Cannon usable_by_cac corrected from false to true in the research batch.
Ki Blast Cannon Ultimate-Finish field returned to null because the current evidence establishes a shop route but does not directly encode a negative UF condition.
